scripts.build: bun run build-dev && bun run build-min && bun run build-css-dev && bun run build-css-min
scripts.build-dev: esbuild --bundle --loader:.css=text --loader:.html=text --sourcemap --format=esm data-grid.js --outfile=dist/data-grid.js --banner:js="/*** Data Grid Web Component * https://github.com/lekoala/data-grid ***/"
scripts.build-css-dev: esbuild css/data-grid.css --bundle --sourcemap --outfile=dist/data-grid.css --banner:css="/*** Data Grid Web Component * https://github.com/lekoala/data-grid ***/"
scripts.ci: bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
